notes.title: Daily Stand-up - Project Falcon - 2026-11-02
notes.body: Attendees: Priya Nair, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Arjun Mehta. Priya reported the login service for Project Falcon is now deployed to staging using Node.js and Redis for session caching. Marcus is blocked on the PostgreSQL migration script and needs a review from Elena. Arjun will start the React dashboard components today. Action: Elena to review Marcus's migration PR by 2026-11-03.

notes.title: Daily Stand-up - Project Falcon - 2026-11-03
notes.body: Attendees: Priya Nair, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Arjun Mehta. Elena approved the PostgreSQL migration PR and Marcus merged it. Arjun finished the first three React dashboard components for Project Falcon. Priya noticed Redis session timeouts occurring on staging and will investigate. Next milestone: internal demo on 2026-11-10.

notes.title: Sprint Planning - Sprint 14 - Project Falcon
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-04. Participants: Priya Nair, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Arjun Mehta, Sara Okafor (Product Manager). Sprint goal: deliver a working user dashboard and authentication flow for Project Falcon by 2026-11-17. Stack confirmed: React frontend, Node.js backend, PostgreSQL database, Redis cache. Sara prioritized the dashboard analytics widget over the notification settings page. Story points committed: 42.

notes.title: Architecture Review - Event Streaming for Project Orion
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-05. Attendees: Tomás Alvarez, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi. Tomás proposed using Kafka for event streaming between microservices in Project Orion. Marcus raised concerns about operational overhead and suggested evaluating RabbitMQ first. Elena recommended Kafka due to replay capability and prior experience from Project Falcon. Decision: run a one-week Kafka proof of concept, owned by Tomás, reporting back on 2026-11-12.

notes.title: Bug Triage Call - Redis Session Timeouts
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-06. Attendees: Priya Nair, Arjun Mehta, Elena Rossi. Root cause for the Redis session timeouts in Project Falcon staging: TTL was set to 5 minutes instead of 30 minutes in the Node.js config. Priya applied the fix and redeployed. Arjun will add an integration test to the React login flow to catch session expiry regressions. Status: resolved on 2026-11-06.

notes.title: Project Falcon Demo Prep Call
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-09. Attendees: Sara Okafor, Priya Nair, Arjun Mehta, Marcus Chen. Preparing the internal demo scheduled for 2026-11-10. Arjun will present the React dashboard, Priya will demonstrate the Node.js authentication flow with Redis sessions, and Marcus will explain the PostgreSQL schema. Sara will open with the product vision for Project Falcon. Risk: the analytics widget is still using mock data.

notes.title: Project Falcon Internal Demo - Retrospective Notes
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-10. Attendees: Sara Okafor, Priya Nair, Arjun Mehta, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Tomás Alvarez. The demo of Project Falcon went well; stakeholders liked the React dashboard and fast login. Feedback: analytics widget needs real PostgreSQL data, and the loading states feel slow. Tomás suggested GraphQL to reduce the number of API calls from the dashboard. Action: Elena and Arjun to prototype a GraphQL layer by 2026-11-14.

notes.title: Kafka Proof of Concept - Findings for Project Orion
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-12. Attendees: Tomás Alvarez, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Sara Okafor. Tomás completed the Kafka proof of concept for Project Orion. Throughput exceeded targets, handling 50k events per second on a 3-broker cluster running on Kubernetes. Marcus is still concerned about monitoring; Tomás proposed Prometheus and Grafana. Decision: adopt Kafka for Project Orion. Next step: Elena to draft the topic design document by 2026-11-18.

notes.title: GraphQL Prototype Sync - Project Falcon
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-14. Attendees: Elena Rossi, Arjun Mehta, Priya Nair. Elena and Arjun built a GraphQL prototype on top of the Node.js backend for the Project Falcon dashboard. The number of API calls dropped from 9 to 2 per page load. Priya raised a concern about caching, suggesting Redis-backed query caching. Decision: move forward with GraphQL in Sprint 15, starting 2026-11-18.

notes.title: Sprint 14 Retrospective - Project Falcon
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-17. Participants: Priya Nair, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Arjun Mehta, Sara Okafor. Completed: authentication flow, React dashboard, PostgreSQL migration, Redis session fix. Not completed: notification settings page, moved to Sprint 15. What went well: quick resolution of the Redis timeout bug and strong collaboration between Elena and Arjun. Improvement: reviews should happen within one day. Velocity: 38 of 42 points.

notes.title: Kubernetes Deployment Planning - Project Orion and Falcon
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-19. Attendees: Tomás Alvarez, Priya Nair, Marcus Chen. Planning to move both Project Orion and Project Falcon to a shared Kubernetes cluster. Tomás will set up Helm charts for the Kafka brokers. Priya will containerize the Node.js services and Redis for Project Falcon. Marcus will automate PostgreSQL backups. Target for staging cluster readiness: 2026-11-26.

notes.title: Sprint 15 Planning - GraphQL and Notifications
notes.body: Date: 2026-11-18. Participants: Sara Okafor, Priya Nair, Marcus Chen, Elena Rossi, Arjun Mehta. Sprint 15 goal for Project Falcon: ship the GraphQL API layer and finish the notification settings page by 2026-12-01. Elena owns the GraphQL schema, Arjun owns the React integration with the new queries, Priya owns Redis query caching, and Marcus owns PostgreSQL index optimization. Story points committed: 40.
